case.toolchains: Rust 1.99.1; nightly-2026-10-01 with Miri; native aarch64 Linux
case.scope: Execution evidence only; no quality points, ranking, skill recommendations, or rubric assigned. Preparation-only control commands were not rerun. No reference implementation or author preparation results were accessed.
case.public_error_adapter: Not applicable: the frozen heapless checks call IndexMap public lookup/membership/iteration APIs directly and scoring.md specifies no error-category adapter for this case. No error strings parsed or categories inferred.
case.general_limit: Focused Miri covers IndexMap unit tests with default features and leak checking disabled, as recorded. Nightly formatting could not run because the installed dated nightly lacks rustfmt. The full cross-target CI/TSan matrix is outside the frozen procedure and was not run.
